instruction: Like all the songs from the artists I follow on Spotify.
notes: The number of followed artists and their songs is only known at runtime, so the problem uses placeholder objects (2 followed artists x 2 songs each); the real plan repeats show_artist/search_songs/like_song for every artist returned by show_following_artists (all pages) and every song returned by search_songs (all pages). Information flow: show_profile gives the login email, show_account_passwords gives the spotify password, login gives the token, show_following_artists reveals which artists are followed (static follows facts become usable), show_artist reveals the artist name used as the search query, search_songs reveals the artist's songs, and like_song requires the song to have been found. Because the goal 'all songs of followed artists are liked' is universal and quantified goals/conditional effects are disallowed, a discrete down-counter (remaining/succ over count objects, with count-0 declared as a domain constant) is consumed by each like_song; supervisor-complete-task requires (remaining count-0), which structurally implies that every placeholder song has been liked exactly once (like_song also forbids re-liking). Only spotify.Song/SongLike are changed, matching the evaluation; no answer is passed to complete_task.
